title: Closed-fibre inverse system of proper finite-type integer models
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, and f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put Y_0=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I) [def-pc-fibre-product]. There are a nonempty directed preordered set \Lambda, an inverse system D:\Lambda^{op}\to\mathrm{Sch}, and a limiting cone \pi:Y_0\to D [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with affine transitions [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and quasi-compact quasi-separated stages [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For each i there are a commutative finite-type integer algebra R_i, \alpha_i:R_i\to A, a proper h_i:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i, p_i:Y\to X_i, and an isomorphism e_i:D_i\cong X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}(R_i/\alpha_i^{-1}I). They satisfy p_i;h_i=f;\operatorname{Spec}\alpha_i, j_Y;p_i=(\pi_i;e_i);j_i, and (\pi_i;e_i);\operatorname{pr}_i=\operatorname{pr}_{A/I};\operatorname{Spec}\bar\alpha_i, where \bar\alpha_i is the induced quotient map and j_Y,j_i are the first pullback projections. No finite etale cover is an input or output.

proof.text: Apply proper Noetherian approximation over Spec A. Use its affine clause, then affine_approximation_ring_presentation to express the same scheme stages over a finite-type ring diagram colimiting to A.
Apply quotient_fibre_limit_transfer to this ring diagram and the limiting scheme cone. This supplies the affine closed-fibre diagram, limiting cone, stage isomorphisms, and projection identities.

For each stage, compose the stage isomorphism with the second pullback projection. Mathlib proper base change and isomorphism stability make this composite proper over the affine quotient spectrum. QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated give compactness and quasi-separatedness. Assemble the ring and scheme witnesses with the two supplied identities and the original commuting square.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GS2 General case and Tag 0A0P; implemented by R1 using ring presentation, quotient-fibre transfer, and Mathlib permanence.

lean.statement: theorem exists_proper_closedFibre_approximation {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] : ∃ (Λ : Type u) (_ : Preorder Λ) (_ : Nonempty Λ) (_ : IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)) (D : Λᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (π : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) ⟶ D), Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk _ π)) ∧ (∀ {i j : Λᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)) ∧ (∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)) ∧ ∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R) (α : R →+* A) (X : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (_ : IsProper h) (p : Y ⟶ X) (e : D.obj i ≅ pullback h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap α))))), p ≫ h = f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α) ∧ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≫ p = (π.app i ≫ e.hom) ≫ pullback.fst h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap α)))) ∧ (π.app i ≫ e.hom) ≫ pullback.snd h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap α)))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.quotientMap I α le_rfl))
